verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships its core library as an installable npm SDK with well-documented client (authClient) and server (auth.api) APIs, plus 20+ framework integrations (Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, Hono) and even an official remote MCP server for AI-agent tooling (docs-18/32/43, probe-4, probe-rt-1). However, community feedback notes the official client library is JS-only with little documentation for building custom clients on non-JS platforms (comm-15), showing a real gap for broader 'official SDK' coverage. Missing for 10: officially documented native SDKs for non-JS/mobile platforms, and independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP server's utility beyond a reachability probe.
